nodes.label: Construction Products Regulation (CPR 2024/1069)
nodes.description: Revised EU Construction Products Regulation establishing harmonized rules for CE marking, mandatory Digital Product Passports (DPP), Environmental Product Declarations (EPD), and circular reuse criteria for structural steel, cement, concrete, and timber.

nodes.label: Energy Performance of Buildings Directive (EPBD 2024/1275)
nodes.description: Mandates Zero-Emission Buildings (ZEB) for all new public buildings by 2028 and all private buildings by 2030, with mandatory calculation of Life-Cycle Global Warming Potential (GWP in kgCO2e/m²) and building renovation passports.

nodes.label: Waste Framework Directive (Directive 2008/98/EC - CDW)
nodes.description: Mandates minimum 70% material recovery, recycling, and preparation for re-use of non-hazardous Construction and Demolition Waste (CDW) across all EU Member States.

nodes.label: Action: CPR Digital Product Passport Deployment
nodes.description: Mandatory digital passports and third-party verified EPD declarations covering global warming potential and recycled content for all commercial construction products.

nodes.label: Action: EPBD Whole-Life Carbon GWP Calculation
nodes.description: Mandatory calculation and reporting of embodied Life-Cycle Global Warming Potential (kgCO2e/m²) required to obtain building construction permits.

nodes.label: Action: Mandatory Selective Demolition & Reuse
nodes.description: Obligatory on-site selective deconstruction audits to salvage structural steel elements and crushed concrete aggregates prior to demolition.

nodes.label: Action: Low-Carbon Concrete & Calcined Clay Transition
nodes.description: Civil engineering and public works contractors replacing high-emission CEM I clinker with blended CEM II/III cements and recycled concrete aggregates.

nodes.label: Reaction: European Construction Rebar Price Volatility
